analysis.environment_evidence_protocol: environment-identity-evidence-protocol-v1 evidence_defined=true; pass_threshold=0.98 with stress_batch camera perturbations.
analysis.temporal_evidence_protocol: temporal-preservation-evidence-protocol-v1 evidence_defined=true; pass_threshold=0.95 with causal_transition_chain highest risk.
analysis.object_evidence_protocol: object-identity-evidence-protocol-v1 evidence_defined=true; pass_threshold=0.97 with hero_prop=0.98 role gate.
analysis.gpu_validation_campaign: PASS_GPU_VALIDATION_CAMPAIGN_V1; campaign_defined=true; sequential channel stage order environment→temporal→object.

evidence_layer_contract.scope: Evidence layer readiness review — Evidence Defined != Evidence Collected.
evidence_layer_contract.gpu_execution: false — readiness review only; no evidence collection or GPU execution in this phase.
evidence_layer_contract.assessment_note: Evidence Validated != GPU Authorized; GPU Authorized != GPU Executed.

evidence_collection_requirements.environment_channel: Collect reference_bank_match_score, traceability_score, and anchor_recall evidence records per ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_DATASET.json batch.
evidence_collection_requirements.temporal_channel: Collect edit_rhythm_alignment_score, continuity_signature_score, and causal_chain_score per TEMPORAL_PRESERVATION_EVIDENCE_DATASET.json batch.
evidence_collection_requirements.object_channel: Collect identity_signature_match_score, texture_match_score, and role_weight_score per OBJECT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_DATASET.json batch.
evidence_collection_requirements.integration_gate: All three channel evidence batches must pass sufficiency rules before GPU authorization precheck may flip evidence_sufficient=true.
evidence_collection_requirements.collection_note: Evidence Defined != Evidence Collected — requirements are schema-only until execution phase.

evidence_sufficiency_rules.environment_sufficiency: Minimum batch pass_rate >= 0.80 with composite_evidence_score >= 0.98 on easy_batch and stress_batch audit.
evidence_sufficiency_rules.temporal_sufficiency: Minimum batch pass_rate >= 0.75 with composite_evidence_score >= 0.95 and causal_chain_score >= 0.90.
evidence_sufficiency_rules.object_sufficiency: Minimum batch pass_rate >= 0.78 with hero_prop_batch pass_rate >= hero_prop_expected_pass_rate (0.20).
evidence_sufficiency_rules.cross_channel_sufficiency: Integration execution sequence stage exit_criteria must be met per channel before layer evidence_sufficient=true.
evidence_sufficiency_rules.sufficiency_note: Evidence Collected != Evidence Validated — sufficiency rules apply after collection and validation.

gpu_authorization_requirements.evidence_sufficient: All three channel evidence batches collected and validated against sufficiency rules.
gpu_authorization_requirements.authorization_note: GPU Authorization must remain FALSE until all requirements met; GPU Authorized != GPU Executed.
